crossRefs.note: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
“As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

translations.web: He caused me to pass by them all around: and behold, there were very many in the open valley; and behold, they were very dry.
translations.bsb: He led me all around among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, and indeed, they were very dry.
translations.kjv: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
translations.asv: And he caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
